fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller (trade-only listing, but still a complete vehicle we can detail).
findings: All five photos taken at dusk, so paint condition is hard to judge
Paint on the doors and bed sides looks somewhat flat rather than glossy in the side shots
Black wheels and tires look dull and undressed
Rear bumper area looks dull and grimy in the rear shot
No interior photos to judge the cabin
message: Hi, we saw your Silverado listing. From the photos the paint on the doors and bed sides looks a little flat, and the wheels and rear bumper could use some attention. We do pre-sale details and come to you, which could help it show better to people offering trades. Would you like a quote?
